hypothesis: row-wise commute demand per owned vehicle and income capacity after adding one vehicle expose a low-depth mobility-affordability boundary that separate raw fields require extra LightGBM splits to approximate
unique_primary_variable: append one frozen three-column row-wise vehicle-demand and income-capacity ratio block

historical_overlap_audit.nearest_precedent: v80 raw fields plus v87 commute-to-charging ratios
historical_overlap_audit.nearest_precedent_boundary: v80 exposes income, commute and car count separately; v87 normalizes commute by charging access, not by owned vehicles or income
historical_overlap_audit.proxy_claim_forbidden: the frozen block represents vehicle capacity and income burden only; it must not be described as observed household size or cost preference

strict_prior_contract.inner_hold: prior and category statistics use only that inner-train partition
strict_prior_contract.outer_valid: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition
strict_prior_contract.test: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition

comparison_boundary: overall OOF compares the same rows against strict v80; fold wins are fixed seed-42 row buckets applied to both complete OOF vectors

diversity_screen.meaning: only permits a later separately preregistered blend test
